description: This file defines the internal dependencies, classes, and interfaces for the Open Fronthaul receiver implementation in the ocudu namespace, including dependency structures, dispatcher, and main receiver class.

classes.name: receiver_impl_dependencies
classes.description: Holds dependencies required by the receiver implementation, including message receiver dependencies, window handler dependencies, symbol reorderer, and Ethernet receiver.

classes.name: receiver_impl
classes.description: Main class implementing the Open Fronthaul receiver, managing dependencies, and providing interfaces for symbol boundary notifications, operation control, and metrics collection.

methods.name: receiver_impl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the receiver with configuration and dependencies.

methods.name: get_ota_symbol_boundary_notifier
methods.description: Returns the notifier for OTA symbol boundary events.

methods.name: get_operation_controller
methods.description: Provides access to the operation controller for starting/stopping receiver operations.

methods.name: get_metrics_collector
methods.description: Returns the metrics collector for the receiver.

methods.name: on_new_symbol
methods.description: Handles new symbol boundary events, dispatching to registered handlers.
